item.title: Weather Update: IMD issues cold day and cold wave alert across North India
item.description: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued alerts for severe cold day and cold wave conditions across several northern states. Eastern Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Uttarakhand, Rajasthan, and Delhi-NCR are expected to experience intense cold, dense fog, and low visibility over the next few days.

item.title: Read The Top News Headlines For Saturday 27 December In One Click
item.description: Stay updated with the biggest headlines for Saturday, 27 December—politics, crime, sports, and more—all summarized for quick reading. Get instant access to breaking news, major developments, and trending stories in just one click. Perfect for busy readers who want news on the go.

item.title: Salman Khan Birthday: Star-studded celebration marks ‘Bhaijaan’ milestone birthday at Panvel Farmhouse
item.description: Bollywood superstar Salman Khan celebrated his 60th birthday with a grand late-night party at his Panvel farmhouse in Navi Mumbai. The celebration witnessed the presence of close family members, friends, and prominent personalities from Bollywood, politics, and sports.

item.title: Mob attacks legendary singer James’ concert in Bangladesh; Event cancelled
item.description: A concert by legendary Bangladeshi singer James was disrupted after a mob attacked the venue in Faridpur, forcing organizers to cancel the event. The incident occurred despite full preparations, leaving several students injured.

item.title: Gold prices skyrocket to Rs 1.40 lakh in Delhi; Check rates across major cities
item.description: Gold and silver prices continue to rise steadily. On December 27, the price of 24-karat gold in Delhi crossed ₹1.40 lakh per 10 grams. Gold prices are also surging in major cities including Mumbai, Chennai, and Kolkata. In the international market, both gold and silver prices are at new record highs.

item.title: How PNB lost Rs 2,434 crore, is the bank at risk? The scam explained
item.description: Punjab National Bank (PNB) is once again embroiled in controversy. A major fraud case involving ₹2,434 crore linked to two companies of the Kolkata-based Srei Group has come to light. The bank identified the fraud in a timely manner and informed the RBI and the stock exchange.

item.title: Delhi Police launches ‘Operation Aaghaat’; 285 arrested ahead of new year
item.description: Ahead of the New Year, Delhi Police launched 'Operation Aaghaat 3.0' to crack down on criminals. During this operation, 285 criminals were arrested, and a large quantity of illegal weapons, liquor, cannabis, and cash were seized.

item.title: Russia strikes Kyiv with missiles, drones amid Trump-Zelensky peace talks
item.description: Amidst the ongoing conflict between Russia and Ukraine, Kyiv was subjected to a massive missile and drone attack on the night of December 27th. Power outages affected several parts of the city, and civilians were warned to take shelter. This attack occurred during preparations for a potential peace meeting between US President Trump and Ukrainian President Zelenskyy.

item.title: Congress CWC meeting begins at Indira Bhawan; Rahul, Sonia Gandhi in attendance
item.description: The Congress Working Committee (CWC) meeting, chaired by Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge, has begun at Indira Bhavan in New Delhi. Several senior leaders, including Rahul Gandhi, Sonia Gandhi, Siddaramaiah, and Shashi Tharoor, are present. The meeting is expected to discuss the leadership change in Karnataka, the party's defeat in the Bihar elections, and future political strategies.

item.title: Thailand–Cambodia Border Tensions Ease After Ceasefire Agreement
item.description: Thailand and Cambodia agreed to a ceasefire after weeks of deadly border clashes involving heavy weapons. The decision ends 20 days of violence, highlights the cost of conflict, and underlines the importance of dialogue and peace efforts.
